verdict.rationale: Pika documents in-video element replacement. Swap Anything swaps characters, outfits, backgrounds or props in a video, and the Add Elements flow lets you paint the area to change and describe the edit. However, the evidence does not say the rest of the frame stays untouched, and the restyle wording (pika-docs-5, pika-docs-42) is tied to images or visuals rather than clearly to video clips. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that unmasked regions of the video stay intact, documented restyling of an element within a video clip, and independent or hands-on corroboration of edit fidelity.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact
